scientific_integrity: Analytical Walsh/rank-one proof; full finite graph-distance calculations are supplementary rather than an all-dimensional certificate. The stated public source date is the original arXiv posting of the motivating Hamming-distance-matrix study, not a publication date for this result.
scientific_limitations: One deleted edge of an unweighted finite binary cube; no claim for weighted, multi-edge, or other graph perturbations. Exact threshold specified by a unique finite spectral equation; no independent audit has been performed.
title: One missing cube edge destroys negative type at a dimension-dependent sharp exponent
